title: FBI-UAP-D021, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-3, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: An artist's digital rendering (illustration) of a reported UAP incident, prepared by the FBI at the request of the Department of War.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the file; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the CSV description, not from the image itself.
This is an artist's rendering, not photographic or sensor evidence — it depicts what an observer described, not a recorded object.
The depiction rests on a single unverified first-hand account from one federal special agent (detailed in DOW-UAP-D079).
The image was created in 2026, roughly three years after the reported 2023 incident, so it is a reconstruction rather than a contemporaneous record.
The exact site is described only as a 'sensitive national security site' and is not named.

key_facts.value: Digital rendering / artistic interpretation (not a photograph)
October 2023 (over a period of two days)
